intended_appearance.sheen: Glossy clear-coated blue wax with visible highlights.
intended_appearance.reflections: Soft studio reflections across the face, distinct highlights around the lip.
intended_appearance.contrast: Gradual face shading with brighter rim highlights and a darker recessed interior.
intended_appearance.edges: Rounded poured outer lip and recessed concentric ridges.
